definitions.explanation: A formal written invitation to an event such as a wedding, party, ceremony, or exhibition. Typically a printed or handwritten card sent by mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
{招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}しましょう→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's reply to the invitation promptly.

examples.japanese: {招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出欠|しゅっけつ}→出欠：09604_shukketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}はがき→返信はがき：23662_henshinhagaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同封|どうふう}→同封：16367_doufuu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Enclosed with the invitation were a map to the venue and a reply postcard for RSVP.

notes:
USAGE: {招待状|しょうたいじょう} refers to the physical written invitation. The act of inviting is ⟦{招待|しょうたい}する→招待する：01833_shoutaisuru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send an invitation)
- {招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (an invitation arrives)
- {招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive an invitation)
- {招待状|しょうたいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧ (reply to an invitation)

In Japanese wedding etiquette, the reply postcard (⟦{返信|へんしん}はがき→返信はがき：23662_henshinhagaki⟧) included with the {招待状|しょうたいじょう} follows specific formatting conventions, such as crossing out the honorific {御|ご} before your own name and adding {寿|ことぶき} decorations.
